# `/account-activities` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /account-activities/v1

`listAccountActivitiesV1` — List account activities

This gets a collection of account activities that satisfy the given query parameters.

- Scopes: idn:account-activity:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, API
- Parameters:
  - `requested-for` (query) — The identity that the activity was requested for. *me* indicates the current user. Mutually exclusive with *regarding-identity*.
  - `requested-by` (query) — The identity that requested the activity. *me* indicates the current user. Mutually exclusive with *regarding-identity*.
  - `regarding-identity` (query) — The specified identity will be either the requester or target of the account activity. *me* indicates the current user. Mutually exclusive with *requested-for* and *requested-by*.
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: type: eq, in, ge, le, lt, ne, isnull, sw; created: gt, lt, ge, le, eq, in, ne, isnull, sw; modified: gt, lt, ge, le, eq, in, ne, isnull, sw — e.g. `type eq "Identity Refresh"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: type, created, modified — e.g. `created`
- Returns 200: array of accountactivity

### GET /account-activities/v1/{id}

`getAccountActivityV1` — Get an account activity

This gets a single account activity by its id.

- Scopes: idn:account-activity:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, API
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The account activity id
- Returns 200: accountactivity
